changes: B1 of the test-runner consolidation per A0 decision doc B-35aa. Three deliverables: (1) packages/main/src/tasks/run-all-smokes.ts — in-house parallel smoke runner with --jobs/--tag/--select/--manifest/--smokes-dir/--quiet flags; spawns each smoke as standalone node child process preserving dist-standalone-executable pattern; aggregates exit codes; per-smoke timeout from manifest. (2) packages/main/smoke-manifest.json — 5 initial entries (run-all-smokes / 3 fast wrapper-root smokes / field-regression-cli); unlisted smokes fall back to directory scan. (3) packages/main/src/tasks/run-all-smokes-smoke.ts — 9-check self-smoke covering PASS/FAIL detection, --tag/--select filters, --jobs equivalence, skip:true honored, directory-scan fallback. Plus 2 new npm scripts: root test:all + packages/main test:run-all-smokes-smoke. The 153 existing *-smoke.ts files and 262 existing test:* scripts are byte-identical to main.
usage: `npm run test:all` runs all discovered smokes in parallel (default = os.cpus().length workers); `npm run test:all -- --tag fast` filters to fast-tagged smokes; `npm run test:all -- --select <substring>` filters by smoke name substring; `npm --prefix packages/main run test:run-all-smokes-smoke` runs the runner's self-smoke (9 checks). B2 (collapse 262 test:* scripts) and B3 (c8 coverage) are follow-up stories.
expectedOutcome: `npm --prefix packages/main run test:run-all-smokes-smoke` exits 0 with 9/9 checks; `node packages/main/dist/tasks/run-all-smokes.js --tag fast` exits 0 with 3/3 passed; build + e2e + validate green; 153 existing smokes + 262 existing test:* scripts byte-identical.
actualTranscript: All gates verified green at HEAD: self-smoke 9/9 PASS exit 0; --select run-all-smokes (dogfood) 1/1 PASS exit 0; --tag fast 3/3 PASS exit 0; --select ZZZZZ_NONEXISTENT 0 matched exit 0; npm run build exit 0; npm run test:e2e ALL PASS; lattice validate PASS 36/36 intent coverage; 153 existing smokes byte-identical (git diff exclude run-all-smokes-smoke = 0); 262 existing test:* byte-identical (no -test: lines in diff); intent-coverage.ts + dev-cli.ts SAFE; 4 review lanes all PASS across 3 rounds; 12 findings raised + 12 resolved; delivery-check signed.
outcomeDiff: No gap. B1 delivered per A0 spec; over-reach guards held; no existing smoke or test:* script touched.
limitations: Bounded by A0 plan: B1 is the runner skeleton only. B2 (collapse 262 test:* scripts to manifest), B3 (c8 coverage + test:coverage entry), and optional B4 (watch / --rerun-failed UX polish) are deferred to follow-up Lattice stories. The runner intentionally does not change any existing smoke or test:* script; gap-log was removed from the initial manifest because gap-log-smoke has a preexisting koala→Lattice rebrand assertion bug (not B-6efb-introduced; should be fixed in a separate story).
pitfalls: 3 REVIEW rounds and 12 findings is high. Lessons that should permanently change behavior: (1) evidence-must-bind-literal-intent-command (memory recorded) was tested again: my evidence helper kept binding multiple intents to a single generic grep — 7 evidence-correspondence findings filed across the 3 rounds. Need a write-time fail-loud guard in the helper. (2) Naming gotcha: the runner strips `-smoke.js` to derive name, so `run-all-smokes-smoke.js` becomes name `run-all-smokes` — `--select run-all-smokes-smoke` never matches. Two high findings (F-010/F-011) flagged this in intent text AND evidence command. Future runner self-smoke conventions should avoid double-suffix patterns or document the stripping clearly. (3) Manifest-data review: F-003 was a real bug — I included gap-log in `fast` tag without verifying it actually passes (it has a koala→Lattice rebrand assertion bug). Pre-merge gate should verify every fast-tagged smoke actually exits 0 on HEAD.
